seoTitle: Filezon Seller: Become a seller of digital goods worldwide - sign up and start selling on the marketplace
seoDescr: Sell products on Filezon digital marketplace and grow your business with us
pageTitle: Sign up for free and get new customers among all internet users.
registerTitle: The registration process is as simple and quick as possible, we promise it won't take long. If you already have a Filezon account, you only need to accept the terms of use.
registerTitle2: Customize your store, specify your desired name and set an image.
uploadProductsTitle2: Format the data in a customer-friendly format
uploadProductsTitle4: Specify the characteristics from the suggested list
uploadProductsTitle5: Upload the finished files to our server
startSellingTitle: Gather your first ratings and reviews by promoting your product through social media and your professional networks.
startSellingTitle2: Your product will be discoverable in our marketplace where you earn revenue from each sale.
startSellingTitle3: If you have any questions we are always in touch in our personal account and social networks.
anyPerson: Any person or company. You do not need any special registration or any documents.
ratesTitle: We charge a flat rate of 5% on every sale. No hidden commissions or fees.
whatSell: What can you sell on Filezon?
whatSellTitle: Any digital files (source code, templates, databases, etc.) that do not violate the rules of the site.
howMuchData: How much data can I sell on Filezon?
howMuchDataTitle: After registration, you will have access to 1 GB of storage space for your products. Product file size is limited only by the free space of your current plan. The number of products is unlimited.
howPayout: How do the payouts take place?
howPayoutTitle: Payouts are on demand, with funds sent to the seller's cryptocurrency wallet.
easyEnter: Easy to enter and easy to understand platform
easyEnterTitle: Register for free, upload your products and start selling. We value your time and have made an intuitive interface.
anonymityTitle: We do not ask for your personal information. We do not have KYC procedures. All monetary transactions take place exclusively by cryptocurrency. We do not share information with third parties.
lowRateTitle: We take a fixed 5% of the sale amount
youPayNothingTitle: Using Filezon with a basic plan is free for you. We have no limit on the number of products.
worldwideTitle: Your customers can be anywhere in the world. Filezon is available to everyone with an internet connection.
